entities.summary: Cole Sillinger is an American-born Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a centre for the Columbus Blue Jackets of the National Hockey League (NHL). Sillinger was selected by the Blue Jackets 12th overall in the 2021 NHL Entry Draft.
